description: Source code for the TiffWriter class in the Android img_utils library, handling TIFF image writing, including tag management, IFD handling, and file writing.

classes.name: TiffWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for writing TIFF files, managing IFDs, tags, and file output.

methods.name: buildTagMap
methods.description: Creates a map from tag definitions for quick lookup.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes TIFF data to output stream, including headers, IFDs, and strips.

methods.name: lookupDefinition
methods.description: Finds tag definition for a given tag ID.

methods.name: getEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific TIFF entry for a given tag and IFD.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes a TIFF entry for a specific tag and IFD.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a new TIFF entry to a specified IFD.

methods.name: addStrip
methods.description: Adds strip tags to an IFD.

methods.name: addIfd
methods.description: Adds a new IFD to the TIFF structure.

methods.name: addSubIfd
methods.description: Adds a sub-IFD (e.g., GPS or SubIFD) to a parent IFD.

methods.name: getDefaultType
methods.description: Returns default data type for a tag.

methods.name: getDefaultCount
methods.description: Returns default count for a tag.

methods.name: checkIfDefined
methods.description: Checks if a tag is defined.

methods.name: getTagName
methods.description: Returns the name of a tag.

methods.name: findLastIfd
methods.description: Finds the last IFD in the linked list.

methods.name: getTotalSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of the TIFF file including headers and IFDs.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs the TIFF structure for debugging.
